support_scenario: User account locked / suspended / password expired
key_fields_returned: status (summary: Account is locked / Account is active / Account is suspended / Password expired / Account not yet activated), is_federated
fin_action: Look up user; check status summary field
notes: Single endpoint covers all three diagnoses plus is_federated check. Summary field drives response selection.

support_scenario: Permission check — requestor can manage users
key_fields_returned: roles[], permissions[] (summary: Requestor can manage users / Requestor cannot manage users)
fin_action: Check requestor has manage users permission before any action
notes: Required before unlock, unsuspend, password reset, or activation email. Roles with manage users: Account owner, Admin, IAM admin.

support_scenario: User permissions — what roles do they have
key_fields_returned: roles[], permissions[] (summary: User has [role name] role: [capability description] / User has no role assigned)
fin_action: Retrieve member record; inspect roles and permissions
notes: Returns roles and permissions. Use roles reference table in responses doc to generate capability summary.

fin_action: List all members; filter by role
notes: Supports: roles (filter), q (search), SortBy, SortOrder, Skip, Limit.

key_fields_returned: enabled (boolean), enforce_sso_sign_in (boolean) (summary: SSO is enabled and required / SSO is enabled but optional / SSO is not enabled)
fin_action: Check if SSO is on for the client
notes: enforce_sso_sign_in=true means users must log in via SSO only.

key_fields_returned: is_federated (boolean) (summary: User authenticates via SSO / User authenticates with Checkout.com login)
fin_action: Check is_federated on the user record
notes: Same call as account status lookup — no additional API call needed if already retrieved.

key_fields_returned: Full SSO config (with security:manage) or high-level summary
notes: Response depth depends on caller permission. Fin will likely get summary only unless granted security:manage.

key_fields_returned: type (otp/webauthn/unknown), enrolled (boolean) per authenticator (summary: MFA enrolled: [type] / MFA not enrolled)
notes: Self-service endpoint — returns MFA for the calling user only.

fin_action: Point to Dashboard — no API call
notes: Direct to Dashboard > Settings > Team. Users with Account owner / Admin / IAM admin role can manage users.

support_scenario: Send password reset / new activation email
fin_action: Send password reset or activation email
notes: Used for both PASSWORD_EXPIRED and STAGED/PROVISIONED states. Returns 409 if already active — handle with already-active response.

fin_action: Reset MFA for a specific user
notes: Requires clientId + userId. Use when user has lost MFA device or needs to re-enrol.

notes: PutMemberRequest fields: roles[], entity_segments{}. entities[] is deprecated — use entity_segments.
